name: Trans-Canada Air Lines retro
commemorates: Trans-Canada Air Lines, Air Canada's predecessor (founded 1937), in its 1940s–1950s style
description: A220-300 C-GNBN (fin 119) in Trans-Canada Air Lines' colours: grey all over; a red band along the windows with two white pinstripes running through them, from just behind the TCA maple leaf by the forward door, deeper ahead of the first windows (a step down under the door), to a point behind the aft door; 'TRANS-CANADA AIR LINES' in widely spaced red capitals over the band; 'AIR CANADA' in small black capitals with the small red roundel under the band behind the forward door; the TCA leaf (a maroon maple leaf, a gold flash and gold 'TCA') ahead of the band under the cockpit; on the grey fin the TCA leaf in a thin gold ring; grey engines.

sources.title: Air Canada A220-300 C-GNBN @YYZ.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, AVA Navigate)
sources.note: Left side on approach, 2025-10-13, near side-on and a little from below: fitted to the measured A220-300 shape (nose, tail, fin tip, both doors, the overwing exit's window; about 25 px off at the ends, so positions along the body were read between the doors and the exit instead). The band's edges, the pinstripes, the titles' ends and the fin's ring read off it.

sources.title: Air Canada A220 C-GNBN in Trans Canada livery.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, Vladsinger)
sources.note: Right side at the gate at Toronto, 2026-09-29, side-on from the terminal: the newest open photo, still in the scheme. The band's front (the step under the forward door), the leaf by the door and the right side's layout checked on it; not fitted (perspective, 40 px off).

sources.note: Left side from below, 2025-06-20: grey belly and engines.

sources.title: Air Canada news release: Modern Airbus A220 to fly Air Canada's legacy TCA livery across North America (2021-02-19)
sources.note: The scheme's unveiling on a new A220-300; it carries on the TCA retro first painted on A319 C-FZUH in 1997 (retired January 2021). Not measured from.

titles.style: Widely spaced red block capitals over the band, from the first windows to over the wing.
Air Canada's own capitals, small and black under the band behind the forward door.

logos.description: TCA's maple leaf in maroon with the gold flash and gold 'TCA', in a thin gold ring, in the middle of the grey fin.
The TCA leaf without its ring, ahead of the band by the forward door.
The small red Air Canada roundel ahead of 'AIR CANADA'.

notes: Measured on the left side (2025-10-13), checked on the right (2026-09-29). Positions along the body were read between the forward door, the overwing exit's window and the aft door (the fit to the measured A220-300 is about 25 px off at the nose and tail, about 0.6 m). The band's front sits behind the TCA leaf, so its exact front edge is hidden; its step under the forward door is drawn straight. Not drawn: the thin red line some photos show under the band's front, the registration and fleet number, the small flag and 'AIRBUS A220-300'. The TCA leaf's lettering in the marks is simplified block capitals.
history: New 2026-11-22. Painted on the new A220-300 C-GNBN in February 2021, carrying on the 1997 TCA retro of A319 C-FZUH; still flying in it (Toronto, 2026-09-29).
